meta: The 5 prompt tips most worth remembering after almost 200 Mark học AI videos. A prompt is the instruction you send to AI.

muc.title: Five tips to remember
muc.text: After almost two hundred videos, if you remember only five prompt tips, the instructions you send to AI, remember these.

muc.title: Examples and a role
muc.text: One: give a few examples for AI to copy, called few-shot. Two: give AI a role, like a strict editor.

muc.title: Step by step, set a format
muc.text: Three: ask AI to think step by step before concluding. Four: set the answer format, like a three-column table.

muc.title: Break big tasks down
muc.text: Five: break big tasks into small steps instead of stuffing everything into one long instruction.

muc.title: Upgrade an old prompt
muc.text: Take a prompt you use often, add one example and an answer format, then compare with the old result.
